text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to take a walk during lunch one
day,
when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Energize your body! Delightful and
refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you what's going on! I'm gonna be
in a
commercial for a sports drink!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The company contacted the academy
directly and
said I'd be a good fit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hearing you say that really pumps
me up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was gonna turn 'em down
at first.
The offer came so suddenly, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm happy to do it if people think it's
a good
idea like you do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I'll go all in, for everyone who's
supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna make a great
commercial!
Delightful and refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That day after class...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just take a deep breath and say to
yourself,
"delightful and refreshing"...
Yeah! I got this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this is the same feeling I get before
a race.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone, let's begin shooting!
Mejiro
Ryan, you're up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: R-right! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Energize your body! Delightful and
refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
And cut! One moment while I check the
take.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's weird, I didn't really do all
that much
physically, but I'm kinda
wiped out from the
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, we might have to take that
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing to do with your
performance. But
there's just something
that doesn't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Your appeal, or rather your essence,
isn't really
shining through in this clip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My "essence"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess a lot of other people would
do a
better job at it than me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They recommended me for the role
because they
thought I fit the brand's
image.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But how can I express my
essence?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Be... myself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I see! So when I'm sweating and out
of
breath, it should be for real, not just
pretend!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And if I move like I normally do, then my

"essence" should show up better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, can I have a little extra time?
I'd like
to go running!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Sure! That could lend an air of realism to
the
commercial and really get the
message through!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Okay, be right back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Thanks, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mention it. If I may say, you
seem
especially spirited right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're right, I am! I worked up a
real good
sweat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're really taking your training
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dober! Perfect timing! Let's go
running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, why would I want to go
running now?!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Dripping with sweat, face flushed but
with an
energetic expression—yes! This is
what a sporty
girl looks like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan continues to run until she's
sweaty
and exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to her efforts, the commercial
turns
out well and the drink starts flying
off the shelves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Be more energetic?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ohh, I see! That's what was missing when it came to showing what I'm really like!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Do you think we could
change
locations? Come with me—I'll
show you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will tell you that I'm all about
the
muscles! So what's missing is... more
muscle!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Uh... m-more?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Lemme start warming them up! You'll
see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Time to get swole!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First we're gonna do some bench
presses! Look at
these pecs come alive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Now my deltoids and forearms are starting to wake up! They wanna know when it's their time to shine!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure I follow you... but I
really love
the energy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the burn now! Next, I'm gonna
get my
lower half going with some leg
presses!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Let's get SWOLE!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, get this on video! There's a lot
more going
on here than in the script we
wrote!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan wins over the staff by just
being
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once the commercial begins airing, it
has a huge
impact, and the drink starts
flying off the shelves.
